Legislative Council
Secretariat

Expenditure)
column7:
Augmentation in
provision of ₹43.00 lakh
was net effect of increase
of ₹ 98.00 lakhand
decrease by re-
appropriation of
₹55.00 lakh. Increase of
₹25.00 lakh was
attributed to need of
additional amounts for
official use furniture in
office expenses. Increase
of ₹18.00 lakh was
attributed to Publication
and Printing and contract
services. Increase of
₹55.00 lakh was
attributed to need of
additional amounts in
office expenses,
maintenance and fuel of
van and legal charges.
Decrease was attributed
to anticipated saving.
Reasons for final saving
have not been intimated
(July 2024).
